title: Home
description: Is anything wrong, and where; the detail is in the other tabs.

panels.title: Control room
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days).

queries.query: ((time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(up{job="kaizen"}) or vector(0)) < 1)[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(up{job="kaizen"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or ((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(max(up{job="kaizen"}))[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(up{job="kaizen"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or -(time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(up{job="kaizen"}) or vector(0)) == 1)[7d:1m])) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Flight tracker
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Down means the public site does not answer with live data.

queries.query: ((time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) < 1)[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or ((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}))[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or -(time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)[7d:1m])) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Home Assistant
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Up means its container runs.

queries.query: ((time() - max(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"}))) and on() (count(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"})) == 1)) or -(time() - min(max by (name) (last_over_time(container_last_seen{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"}[7d])))) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: DNS and proxy
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). The .internal names: up means both containers run.

queries.query: ((time() - max(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"}))) and on() (count(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"})) == 2)) or -(time() - min(max by (name) (last_over_time(container_last_seen{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"}[7d])))) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: CI runner
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Up means at least one job VM runs (ready ones included).

queries.query: ((time() - max_over_time(timestamp((clamp_max(count(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="ci-vms",id=~"/firecracker/ci-slot[0-9]+"}), 1) or vector(0)) < 1)[7d:1m])) and on() ((clamp_max(count(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="ci-vms",id=~"/firecracker/ci-slot[0-9]+"}), 1) or vector(0)) == 1)) or ((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(max(up{job="integrations/unix"}))[7d:1m])) and on() ((clamp_max(count(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="ci-vms",id=~"/firecracker/ci-slot[0-9]+"}), 1) or vector(0)) == 1)) or -(time() - max_over_time(timestamp((clamp_max(count(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="ci-vms",id=~"/firecracker/ci-slot[0-9]+"}), 1) or vector(0)) == 1)[7d:1m])) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Backup
panels.description: Time since the last good nightly backup; red past 26 h, when the backup alert fires.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: OpenObserve's alert rules firing now. Until the cutover they post nowhere (their shadow posts are refused), so a firing rule shows here and in the Alerts tab only.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT status, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY _timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM triggers WHERE module = 'alert') WHERE rn = 1 AND status IN ('firing', 'notify_failed')

panels.title: Memory by group
panels.description: Kaizen is its Control room; CI VMs its job machines; Monitoring the observability stack; Apps every other container; System the rest of the host's memory in use, which reads 0 when the groups' own counts add up past it.

queries.query: sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="docker",name!=""})) - (sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="docker",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="kaizen-control-room"})) or vector(0)) - (sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="docker",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="observability"})) or vector(0))

panels.title: CPU by group, cores
panels.description: Kaizen is its Control room; CI VMs its job machines; Monitoring the observability stack; Apps every other container; System the rest of the host's memory in use, which reads 0 when the groups' own counts add up past it.

queries.query: sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="docker",name!=""}[5m]))) - (sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="docker",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="kaizen-control-room"}[5m]))) or vector(0)) - (sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="docker",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="observability"}[5m]))) or vector(0))

clamp_min(max(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal",job="integrations/unix"}[5m]))) - sum(max by (name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="docker",name!=""}[5m]))) - (sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="ci-vms",id=~"/firecracker/ci-slot[0-9]+"}[5m])) or vector(0)), 0)

panels.title: Error lines per hour, by container
panels.description: Lines that log an error, a fatal or a Python exception.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, container_name AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _timestamp, container_name, body FROM containers WHERE (match_all('error') OR match_all('fatal') OR match_all('panic') OR match_all('crit') OR match_all('critical') OR match_all('exception') OR match_all('limited')) AND (level IN ('error', 'fatal', 'critical') OR regexp_like(body, '^.{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(?i:level=(error|fatal|crit))|^(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |^[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): '))) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Most repeated error lines, last hour
panels.description: Numbers and ids show as #, so repeats of one error count together.

queries.query: SELECT container_name AS x_axis_1, substr(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(body, '\x1b\[[0-9;]*m|^\S*\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[T ][0-9:.,]+\S*\s*', '', 'g'), '[0-9a-f]*[0-9][0-9a-f]*', '#', 'g'), 1, 200) AS x_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_1, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)), '%H:%M') AS y_axis_2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _timestamp, container_name, body FROM containers WHERE (match_all('error') OR match_all('fatal') OR match_all('panic') OR match_all('crit') OR match_all('critical') OR match_all('exception') OR match_all('limited')) AND (level IN ('error', 'fatal', 'critical') OR regexp_like(body, '^.{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(?i:level=(error|fatal|crit))|^(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |^[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): '))) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

queries.query: SELECT to_char(to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS x_axis_1, max(CASE WHEN regexp_like(body, '^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)') THEN body END) AS x_axis_2, (max(CASE WHEN regexp_like(body, '^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)') THEN _timestamp END) - min(_timestamp)) / 1000000 AS y_axis_1, max(CASE WHEN body = 'deep check ok' THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END) AS x_axis_3 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _timestamp, body FROM containers WHERE container_name = 'backup') GROUP BY date_trunc('day', to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp)) HAVING max(CASE WHEN regexp_like(body, '^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Alerts that fired
panels.description: Each rule that fired in the time range, and when; still firing if its last time is this minute.

queries.query: SELECT split_part(key, '/', 1) AS x_axis_1, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS x_axis_2, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM triggers WHERE module = 'alert' AND status IN ('firing', 'notify_failed') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_3 DESC

panels.title: Rules firing, by hour
panels.description: Minutes each rule fired in each hour.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, split_part(key, '/', 1) AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM triggers WHERE module = 'alert' AND status IN ('firing', 'notify_failed') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
